This is the 2023 corporate logo of Warner Bros. Entertainment, which uses the Warner Bros. Discovery shield. Currently used since 2023 as an on-screen logo, and also used as the logo for its studio tours in Hollywood, London, and Tokyo. This logo was designed by Chermayeff & Geismar & Haviv, and initially used as the corporate logo of Warner Bros. Discovery. The logo is also seen at multiple divisions and properties owned by Warner Bros. such as Warner Bros. Television, Warner Bros. International Television Production, and Warner Bros. Studios in Burbank, specifically on its Water Tower.
